identifiers: Fully qualified project.dataset.view; validated independently of bound query values.

metadata_columns.import_sequence: STRING: unsigned decimal MySQL sequence, no floating conversion
metadata_columns.filename: STRING: original CSV basename, maximum 120 characters
metadata_columns.checksum: STRING: lowercase SHA256 hex of submitted UTF-8 CSV
metadata_columns.updated_at: TIMESTAMP: UTC final immutable snapshot revision

record_columns.record_number: INT64: dense unique 2..total_rows+1 including failed/cancelled records
record_columns.cells_json: STRING: JSON array [SkuId,StoreId,IsActive], three source CSV strings each at most128 characters
record_columns.command_json: STRING NULL: strict JSON {kind:"parent-store",productId:positive decimal string,storeId:positive decimal string,active:boolean}; invalid/duplicate syntax rows may be null
record_columns.message: STRING NULL: static record result, maximum 255 characters

integrity: Separate parent-store publication; never substitute six-column stock cells/commands or fabricate source CsvUpload UUID execution receipts.
Exactly one immutable metadata record per import UUID/sequence.
All records belong to the same owner/checksum/created_at/updated_at snapshot.
Metadata is published only with the complete final record snapshot; duplicate rows are invalid.
CANCELLED has total_rows-processed_rows cancelled records and no pending records.
Record counts/status totals/dense numbering are verified before serving.
Keep compact MySQL authorization/idempotency metadata; historical record bodies need no MySQL read fallback.

physical_design_to_verify.note: Validate actual partition pruning, view policies, materialization/freshness and maximumBytesBilled before enabling. No DDL was executed.
